# AllPay Hosted Fields Styling Fix Guide

## Problem Summary

**Issue:** AllPay payment form iframe displays with default black background and styling instead of custom transparent amber design matching the registration form.

**Symptoms:**
- Preview mode in AllPay dashboard shows correct styling (transparent, amber inputs)
- Live website shows black background with default AllPay styling
- Input fields don't match the registration form design

**Root Cause:** Custom CSS configured in AllPay's Hosted Fields Settings is not being applied to the payment URLs generated by the backend API.

---

## Solution Steps

### Step 1: Access AllPay Dashboard Hosted Fields Settings

1. **Log into AllPay Dashboard**
   - URL: https://allpay.to/login
   - Use your merchant credentials

2. **Navigate to Hosted Fields Settings**
   - Click **Settings** in the left sidebar
   - Click **Hosted Fields** section
   - Click **Hosted Fields Settings** button

3. **Verify Domain Whitelist**

   In the "Allowed Domains" section, ensure these domains are added (one per line):
   ```
   aikidz.club
   *.aikidz.club
   www.aikidz.club
   localhost
   127.0.0.1
   *.vercel.app
   ```

### Step 2: Configure Custom CSS

In the **Custom CSS** section of Hosted Fields Settings, paste this complete CSS:

```css
/* ========================================
   AllPay Hosted Fields Custom Styling
   Matches AI Club Registration Form Design
   ======================================== */

/* Remove ALL default backgrounds globally */
* {
    background-color: transparent !important;
}

/* Body and main containers - transparent */
body {
    background: transparent !important;
    margin: 0 !important;
    padding: 0 !important;
    font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif !important;
}

/* Specifically target common container classes */
.wrapper, .form-group, .field-group, .input-group,
.field-wrapper, .input-wrapper, .row, .col,
.container, .payment-form, .checkout-form,
div[class*="container"] {
    background: transparent !important;
    border: none !important;
    padding: 0 !important;
    box-shadow: none !important;
}

/* Input fields - EXACTLY matching your registration form */
input, .card-field, input[type="text"], input[type="tel"],
select, textarea, .input-field, .form-input {
    /* Light amber semi-transparent background - same as registration */
    background: rgba(69, 26, 3, 0.4) !important;  /* bg-amber-950/40 */

    /* Light amber border */
    border: 1px solid rgba(254, 243, 199, 0.3) !important;  /* border-amber-200/30 */

    /* Large rounded corners */
    border-radius: 12px !important;  /* rounded-xl */

    /* White text */
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1) !important;  /* text-white */

    /* Generous padding */
    padding: 20px 24px !important;  /* px-6 py-5 */

    /* Large text */
    font-size: 18px !important;  /* text-lg */

    /* Subtle shadow */
    box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05) !important;

    transition: all 0.2s ease !important;
    width: 100% !important;

    /* Backdrop blur for glassmorphism */
    backdrop-filter: blur(10px) !important;
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(10px) !important;
}

/* Placeholder text - light amber */
input::placeholder, textarea::placeholder, select::placeholder,
::-webkit-input-placeholder, ::-moz-placeholder, :-ms-input-placeholder {
    color: rgba(252, 211, 77, 1) !important;  /* placeholder-amber-300 */
    opacity: 1 !important;
}

/* Focus state - cyan ring matching registration form */
input:focus, .card-field:focus, select:focus, textarea:focus {
    outline: none !important;
    border-color: transparent !important;
    /* Cyan focus ring - same as registration */
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(6, 182, 212, 1) !important;  /* focus:ring-2 focus:ring-cyan-400 */
}

/* Labels - white text */
label, .label, .field-label {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9) !important;
    font-size: 14px !important;
    font-weight: 500 !important;
    margin-bottom: 8px !important;
    background: transparent !important;
}

/* Error messages - subtle red */
.error-message, .validation-error, .field-error, .error {
    color: rgba(254, 202, 202, 1) !important;
    background: rgba(153, 27, 27, 0.15) !important;
    border: 1px solid rgba(252, 165, 165, 0.3) !important;
    border-radius: 8px !important;
    padding: 8px 12px !important;
    font-size: 14px !important;
    margin-top: 6px !important;
}

/* Success messages */
.success-message, .success {
    color: rgba(187, 247, 208, 1) !important;
    background: rgba(20, 83, 45, 0.15) !important;
    border: 1px solid rgba(134, 239, 172, 0.3) !important;
    border-radius: 8px !important;
    padding: 8px 12px !important;
}

/* Powered by Allpay - subtle */
.powered-by, .footer-text, .branding, .footer, small {
    color: rgba(254, 243, 199, 0.5) !important;
    font-size: 11px !important;
    background: transparent !important;
}

/* Select dropdown options */
select option {
    background: rgba(69, 26, 3, 0.95) !important;
    color: white !important;
}

/* Helper text */
.help-text, .hint-text {
    color: rgba(254, 243, 199, 0.7) !important;
    font-size: 13px !important;
    background: transparent !important;
}

/* Card icons */
.card-icon, .payment-icon, img, svg {
    opacity: 0.8 !important;
}

/* Ensure spacing between fields */
.field-group, .form-group {
    margin-bottom: 16px !important;
}

/* Target month/year separator */
.separator, .divider, span {
    color: rgba(254, 243, 199, 0.8) !important;
    background: transparent !important;
}

/* Remove box-shadow from nested containers */
.payment-form, .checkout-form {
    box-shadow: none !important;
}

/* Buttons styling (if AllPay includes buttons) */
button, .button, input[type="submit"] {
    background: linear-gradient(to right, rgb(6, 182, 212), rgb(20, 184, 166)) !important;
    color: white !important;
    font-weight: bold !important;
    padding: 12px 24px !important;
    border-radius: 12px !important;
    border: none !important;
    cursor: pointer !important;
    transition: all 0.2s ease !important;
}

button:hover, .button:hover, input[type="submit"]:hover {
    opacity: 0.9 !important;
    transform: scale(1.02) !important;
}

/* Disabled state */
button:disabled, input:disabled {
    opacity: 0.5 !important;
    cursor: not-allowed !important;
}
```

### Step 3: Save and Test Configuration

1. **Click Save** at the bottom of Hosted Fields Settings page

2. **Wait 1-2 minutes** for AllPay to propagate the changes

3. **Clear browser cache** (important!)
   - Chrome: Cmd+Shift+Delete (Mac) or Ctrl+Shift+Delete (Windows)
   - Select "Cached images and files"
   - Click "Clear data"

4. **Test the payment form:**
   - Go to your website: https://aikidz.club/mobile.html#choose-program
   - Fill out Steps 1-3 of registration form
   - Proceed to Step 4 (Payment)
   - The iframe should now show transparent background with amber inputs

### Step 4: Verify iframe Styling in Browser

1. **Open browser Developer Tools** (F12 or right-click → Inspect)

2. **Locate the iframe element:**
   ```html
   <iframe id="allpay-payment-iframe" ...>
   ```

3. **Check if CSS is being loaded:**
   - Right-click iframe → "Inspect"
   - Look for `<style>` tags in iframe's `<head>`
   - Verify your custom CSS appears there

4. **Check for console errors:**
   - Look for CORS errors
   - Look for CSS loading failures
   - Look for domain restriction errors

## Troubleshooting

### Issue 1: Iframe Still Shows Black Background

**Possible Causes:**
- Browser cache not cleared
- Domain not whitelisted in AllPay
- CSS not saved properly

**Solutions:**
1. Clear browser cache completely
2. Try in incognito/private browsing window
3. Re-save CSS in AllPay dashboard
4. Check AllPay domain whitelist includes your domain
5. Wait 5 minutes for AllPay CDN to propagate changes

### Issue 2: Preview Works but Live Doesn't

**Possible Causes:**
- Domain restrictions
- API parameters missing styling flags
- AllPay account settings

**Solutions:**
1. Verify domain whitelist in AllPay dashboard
2. Contact AllPay support with account details
3. Ask if custom CSS requires specific API parameters
4. Request they enable custom styling for your account

### Issue 3: Some Elements Styled, Others Not

**Possible Causes:**
- AllPay using different CSS class names
- CSS specificity issues
- AllPay overriding with inline styles

**Solutions:**
1. Inspect iframe elements to find actual class names
2. Add `!important` to all CSS rules (already done in CSS above)
3. Add more specific selectors for problematic elements
4. Contact AllPay support for CSS class documentation

### Issue 4: Mobile vs Desktop Different

**Possible Causes:**
- AllPay serves different HTML on mobile
- Browser rendering differences

**Solutions:**
1. Test on actual mobile device (not just browser resize)
2. Add mobile-specific CSS media queries if needed
3. Ensure `viewport` meta tag is correct
4. Check if AllPay has separate mobile CSS settings

- [ ] Input fields have light amber border

## Alternative: Contact AllPay Support

If styling still doesn't apply after following all steps above, contact AllPay support:

**Email:** support@allpay.to

**Include in your email:**

1. **Subject:** "Hosted Fields Custom CSS Not Applying"

2. **Your account details:**
   - Login: [your ALLPAY_LOGIN]
   - Merchant name: AI Club / aikidz.club

3. **Problem description:**
   ```
   I have configured custom CSS in Hosted Fields Settings, and it displays correctly
   in the preview mode. However, when the payment form is loaded via the API
   (payment_url) on my live website, the default black styling appears instead
   of my custom CSS.

   Domain: aikidz.club
   Payment creation endpoint: /api/create-payment
   ```

4. **Screenshots:**
   - Screenshot of AllPay preview showing correct styling
   - Screenshot of live website showing black styling
   - Screenshot of your Hosted Fields Settings page

5. **Questions to ask:**
   - Do I need to pass specific parameters in the API call to enable custom CSS?
   - Is custom CSS enabled for my account?
   - Why does preview work but live doesn't?
   - Are there any domain-specific restrictions?

## Backend Code Review

Your backend code in `/api/create-payment.js` is correct and includes all necessary parameters:

✅ `login` - Your AllPay merchant login
✅ `order_id` - Unique order identifier
✅ `currency` - ILS
✅ `lang` - HE (Hebrew) or EN (English)
✅ `items` - Product details
✅ `notifications_url` - Webhook URL
✅ `success_url` - Success redirect
✅ `backlink_url` - Back button URL
✅ `show_bit` - Enable Bit payment
✅ `show_applepay` - Enable Apple Pay
✅ `sign` - Security signature

**No changes needed to backend code.**

The styling issue is purely in AllPay's Hosted Fields configuration, not in your code.

## Summary

The issue is that AllPay's Hosted Fields custom CSS is not being applied to your payment URLs. The solution is to:

1. ✅ Verify domain whitelist in AllPay dashboard
2. ✅ Save custom CSS in Hosted Fields Settings (provided above)
3. ✅ Clear browser cache
4. ✅ Test the payment form
5. ✅ Contact AllPay support if issue persists

**Your backend code is correct and doesn't need changes.**

The fix is purely in AllPay's dashboard configuration.
